notes: Suite 366 1.21.0: Microsoft 365 mailboxes now sync, send and file mail through Microsoft Graph, with no Exchange PowerShell step (admins grant Mail.ReadWrite and Mail.Send to the domain app in Azure; IMAP/SMTP stays available as an advanced option), with an Azure setup guide when adding a Microsoft 365 domain. Admins can retry all failed mailboxes from the Mailboxes tab. CRM calendar view with drag and drop and click-to-create; co-organizers for meetings created by an agent.
